newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine BAESA Q1 loss $16.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine BAESA Q1 loss $16.7 mln.

text.p: Net loss $16.7 million vs $22.9 million loss

NOTE: BAESA, the biggest Pepsi Co bottler outside the United States, said in report that in the first quarter it posted an operating profit of $6.9 million against a profit of $9.2 million in the same period year ago.
However, after the cost of debt restructuring and other charges the operating profit fell to $3.5 million. That compares with an operating loss of $2.3 million in the same period of 1996.
The company also reported a $23 million loss from financial expenditures and other charges, versus an $18.8 million loss.
